title: Critical path: improve the path that drives the finish
alt: Integration 0–5, verification 5–8, approval 8–10 form a ten-day critical path. UI 0–6 has four days of float.

title: A forecast is a distribution, conditional on assumptions
alt: Illustrative completion distribution: median 5 weeks, 85th percentile 6 weeks. This is a model, not a commitment.

title: Capacity: nominal availability is only the starting point
alt: Forty person-days minus four leave, six support and four coordination leaves twenty-six planned person-days, subject to skills and dependencies.

title: Earned value: compare planned work, accepted work, and cost
alt: PV 100, EV 80, AC 90. CPI equals 0.89; SPI equals 0.80. Schedule variance is work value, not days.

title: A burnup separates scope arrival from completed work
alt: Two charts show remaining work versus scope and completion. At day four remaining work rises because scope increases, despite continued completion.

title: Cumulative flow: a growing band makes waiting visible
alt: A stacked area chart of done, review, development and not-started items totals twenty each day. Review accumulation warrants investigation.

title: Error budget: define the denominator before doing the math
alt: The budget is one thousand failed requests. Seven hundred failures consume seventy percent, leaving three hundred. This is not an outage-minute calculation.

title: Project delivery connects decisions to outcomes
alt: Project delivery connects decisions to outcomes. Healthcare, Fintech, and Cybersecurity change the evidence and consequences at every step. Product, Delivery, and Presales contribute at their boundaries.

title: Scope change is a decision with visible consequences
alt: Scope change is a decision with visible consequences. An adaptive backlog supports learning. It does not silently change a contract, funding boundary, or essential control.

title: Scrum: artifacts make goals, plans, and quality inspectable
alt: Scrum: artifacts make goals, plans, and quality inspectable. Developers adapt the Sprint plan with the Product Owner as they learn. Selected items are a forecast; quality is not an optional leftover.

title: Lead time, cycle time, and age use explicit boundaries
alt: Lead time, cycle time, and age use explicit boundaries. Use consistent calendar or working-time clocks. These numbers describe an illustrative example, not a forecast for every item.

title: A risk record should lead to action and a decision
alt: A risk record should lead to action and a decision. Completing a mitigation task does not prove the risk disappeared. A realized threat can become an issue requiring resolution.

title: A status update should make the next decision easier
alt: A status update should make the next decision easier. Illustrative: certification threatens launch by one week; sponsor chooses smaller initial scope or a revised date by Friday.

title: A behavioral answer connects your action to evidence
alt: A behavioral answer connects your action to evidence. Spend most of the answer on your reasoning and actions. A polished story without a clear responsibility provides weak evidence.

title: Migration readiness includes a credible recovery path
alt: Migration readiness includes a credible recovery path. Reverting code is not enough if the new system has accepted writes. Assess data compatibility, RTO, RPO, and forward recovery.

title: Release approval applies to an explicit boundary
alt: Release approval applies to an explicit boundary. Stopping further rollout does not undo data already changed. Reassess readiness after material changes or failed guardrails.

title: DORA research measures delivery at a service boundary
alt: DORA research measures delivery at a service boundary. Five metrics in the checked guide. Pair them with user outcomes and service reliability. This research is distinct from EU DORA regulation.

title: Patient data can leave through secondary paths
alt: Patient data can leave through secondary paths. HIPAA scope, GDPR processing conditions, and other applicable duties require separate assessment. Removing names alone is not a de-identification method.

title: FHIR integration: transport success is one layer of evidence
alt: FHIR integration: transport success is one layer of evidence. A successful response can still carry the wrong unit or patient mapping. FHIR does not itself implement the complete security or consent process.

title: Clinical evaluation asks three different evidence questions
alt: Clinical evaluation asks three different evidence questions. Workflow safety also depends on identity, handoffs, people, downtime, and response. UAT alone does not establish all clinical evidence.

title: A card payment has several distinct states
alt: A card payment has several distinct states. Refunds, reversals, disputes, and fees add separate events. Checkout success, authorization, settlement, and payout are not interchangeable.

title: Timeout means the result is unknown to the caller
alt: Timeout means the result is unknown to the caller. Blind failover to another provider can duplicate a successful payment. Providers do not share one universal idempotency boundary.

title: Reconciliation compares independent records
alt: Reconciliation compares independent records. Example: 100 gross minus 3 fee gives 97 net. A mismatch needs an owner and controlled resolution; replaying every record can move money twice.

title: Draw payment-data scope before making compliance claims
alt: Draw payment-data scope before making compliance claims. Outsourcing does not automatically remove merchant obligations. Include secondary tools and systems that can affect the payment environment.

title: Secure delivery is an evidence chain
alt: Secure delivery is an evidence chain. SSDF addresses development practices; ASVS supports verifiable application requirements. A final penetration test is one bounded assessment.

title: Incident coordination needs parallel owners
alt: Incident coordination needs parallel owners. The PM supports coordination within the incident structure. Availability recovery does not automatically resolve data impact or investigation.

title: IAM rollout: protection, usability, and recovery travel together
alt: IAM rollout: protection, usability, and recovery travel together. MFA enabled in one portal does not prove every access path is protected. OTP and out-of-band methods are not automatically phishing-resistant.

title: SOC capability is a tested detection-to-response chain
alt: SOC capability is a tested detection-to-response chain. An ATT&CK mapping is not proof of detection. Test missing telemetry, noisy alerts, unavailable analysts, and the actual response path.

title: Presales evidence should survive the handover
alt: Presales evidence should survive the handover. A polished demo does not prove production readiness. Resolve differences between the signed agreement and the assumptions used for the estimate.

title: Role boundaries follow decisions, not titles
alt: Role boundaries follow decisions, not titles. One person may hold several responsibilities. Preserve clear authority for each decision, including Scrum accountabilities where applicable.

title: Severity is one input to vulnerability prioritization
alt: Severity is one input to vulnerability prioritization. CVSS describes severity; EPSS predicts CVE exploitation; KEV records known exploitation. None alone gives organizational risk.

title: RICE makes prioritization assumptions visible
alt: RICE makes prioritization assumptions visible. A tied score does not make the options equivalent. Essential controls and applicable obligations require explicit treatment.
